details: ➔ Client : Open Bank – Spain
Domain : Banking
The goal of the project at Openbank Spain was to implement and streamline cheque guarantee
functionality within the T24 Core Banking system, ensuring secure handling of high-value and sensi- tive cheque transactions. The initiative aimed to provide customers with certified cheques backed
by the bank, thereby increasing trust and reliability in payments such as property down payments
or large financial commitments. The project focused on enabling guarantee initiation, cancella- tions, stop payments, and handling of non-presented cheques during the validity period, with funds
managed securely in suspense accounts. Ultimately, the objective was to enhance transaction secu- rity, improve customer confidence, and align with Openbank Spain’s commitment to robust, com-
pliant, and efficient digital banking operations.
• Led Agile delivery of cheque guarantee functionality within the T24 Core Banking system,
enabling secure initiation, cancellation, stop payments, and non-payment handling of certi- fied cheques.
• Facilitated Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives) to ensure it- erative progress across design, development, testing, and deployment phases.
• Collaborated with cross-functional squads (Core Banking, Payments, Compliance, Risk, and
Operations) to prioritize backlog items and deliver incremental enhancements aligned with
Openbank Spain’s regulatory and customer requirements.
• Managed sprint-based integration activities, ensuring seamless handling of suspense ac- counts, guarantee validity periods, and customer account reconciliation.
• Partnered with vendors and internal stakeholders to validate solution design, conduct
proof-of-concept trials, and optimize system performance for high-value cheque transac- tions.
• Developed training and enablement materials for operations and customer service teams,
ensuring adoption of new cheque guarantee processes and compliance with banking stand- ards.
• Applied Agile metrics (velocity, burndown charts, defect tracking) to monitor progress,
identify risks, and proactively mitigate issues during rollout.
• Delivered measurable outcomes, strengthening transaction security, improving customer
trust in certified cheques, and aligning with Openbank Spain’s commitment to robust and
efficient digital banking operations.
➔ Client : Open Bank – Spain
Domain : Banking
Role : Project Manager
The goal of the project was to enhance Openbank Spain’s T24 Core Banking system to ensure com- pliance with Spanish Tax Authority regulations governing joint accounts and deposits. Specifically,
the system needed to validate that all beneficial owners of a joint account or deposit share the
same residential status—either all residents of Spain or all non-residents. The initiative aimed to
prevent the creation of joint accounts with mixed residency status, enforce accurate validations
during account opening, and provide clear error messaging when rules were violated. By imple- menting these controls, the project sought to strengthen regulatory compliance, improve opera-
tional accuracy, and safeguard customer trust in Openbank Spain’s account management processes.
• Led Agile delivery of compliance enhancements in the T24 Core Banking system to enforce
Spanish Tax Authority rules on joint accounts and deposits.
• Facilitated Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives) to drive iter- ative progress across requirement validation, system design, development, and testing.
• Collaborated with cross-functional squads (Core Banking, Compliance, Risk, IT, and Opera- tions) to prioritize backlog items and ensure regulatory alignment.
• Defined user stories and acceptance criteria for residency validation, ensuring the system
correctly restricted joint accounts to either all residents or all non-residents.
• Managed sprint-based system integration and testing activities, validating error messages
and exception handling for mixed residency scenarios.
• Partnered with stakeholders and vendors to ensure solution design adhered to compliance
standards and operational workflows.
• Developed training and enablement materials for branch and operations staff to ensure
smooth adoption of new account validation processes.
• Applied Agile metrics (velocity, burndown charts, defect tracking) to monitor delivery pro- gress, identify risks, and proactively mitigate issues.
• Delivered measurable outcomes, strengthening regulatory compliance, improving opera- tional accuracy, and safeguarding customer trust in Openbank Spain’s account management
processes.
➔ Client : Open Bank – Spain
Domain : Banking
Role : Project Manager
The goal of the project was to implement account verification functionality within Openbank
Spain’s T24 Core Banking system using the BBAN (Basic Bank Account Number) standard, enabling
secure and efficient validation of customer accounts across participating banks in Spain. The initia- tive aimed to reduce documentation overhead and streamline background verification processes by
automating the handling of incoming verification requests from other banks and outgoing requests
initiated by Openbank. By ensuring accurate and timely account verification, the project sought to strengthen interbank collaboration, improve operational efficiency, and enhance customer trust in
Openbank Spain’s digital banking services.
• Led Agile delivery of BBAN-based account verification functionality within Openbank
Spain’s T24 Core Banking system, reducing documentation overhead and streamlining back- ground checks.
• Facilitated Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives) to ensure it- erative progress across design, development, testing, and deployment phases.
• Collaborated with cross-functional squads (Core Banking, Compliance, IT Security, and Op- erations) to prioritize backlog items and deliver incremental enhancements aligned with
Spanish interbank standards.
• Defined user stories and acceptance criteria for handling both incoming verification re- quests from participating banks and outgoing requests initiated by Openbank.
• Managed sprint-based integration activities, ensuring seamless API communication and ac- curate validation of account verification status across interbank networks.
• Partnered with vendors and internal stakeholders to validate solution design, conduct
proof-of-concept trials, and optimize system performance for real-time verification.
• Developed training and enablement materials for operations and customer service teams,
ensuring adoption of new verification processes and compliance with regulatory require- ments.
• Applied Agile metrics (velocity, burndown charts, defect tracking) to monitor delivery pro- gress, identify risks, and proactively mitigate issues during rollout.
• Delivered measurable outcomes, strengthening interbank collaboration, improving opera- tional efficiency, and enhancing customer trust in Openbank Spain’s account verification
services.
➔ Client : Bank International Luxembourg
Domain : Banking
Role : Project Manager
The goal of the project was to implement and strengthen Deposit Interest Retention Tax (DIRT)
compliance processes within Bank International Luxembourg’s core banking systems, ensuring accu- rate deduction and reporting of tax on customer deposit interest. The initiative aimed to automate
the calculation and withholding of DIRT at the statutory rate of 41% before interest payments were
credited to customers, while also enabling mandatory reporting to the Revenue authorities when
annual interest exceeded predefined thresholds. By embedding these controls, the project sought
to reduce manual overhead, ensure regulatory compliance, improve transparency in customer tax
obligations, and safeguard the bank’s adherence to income tax and reporting standards.
• Led Agile delivery of Deposit Interest Retention Tax (DIRT) compliance enhancements
within Bank International Luxembourg’s core banking systems, ensuring accurate tax deduc- tion and reporting.
• Facilitated Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives) to drive iter- ative progress across requirement gathering, system design, development, and testing.
• Collaborated with cross-functional squads (Tax Compliance, Core Banking, IT, Risk, and Op- erations) to prioritize backlog items and deliver incremental features aligned with regula-
tory mandates.
• Defined user stories and acceptance criteria for automated DIRT calculation at 41%, with- holding before interest payments, and mandatory reporting to Revenue when thresholds
were exceeded.
• Managed sprint-based integration activities, ensuring seamless reconciliation between cus- tomer accounts, tax reporting modules, and regulatory systems.
• Partnered with vendors and internal stakeholders to validate solution design, conduct
proof-of-concept trials, and optimize system performance for tax compliance.
• Developed training and enablement materials for operations and customer service teams to ensure adoption of new tax reporting processes and compliance with income tax standards.
• Applied Agile metrics (velocity, burndown charts, defect tracking) to monitor delivery pro- gress, identify risks, and proactively mitigate issues during rollout.
• Delivered measurable outcomes, reducing manual overhead, ensuring regulatory compli- ance, improving transparency in customer tax obligations, and safeguarding Bank Interna-
tional Luxembourg’s adherence to reporting standards.
➔ Client : Nordea – Finland
Domain : Banking
Role : Project Manager
The goal of the project was to enable 24/7 loan applications, top-ups, and disbursement requests
across Nordea Finland’s digital channels (mobile, internet banking, and call center) while ensuring
compliance with Finnish Consumer Rights legislation. The initiative focused on embedding business
rules into the core banking system to enforce the legal requirement that any loan approved be- tween 23:00 EET and 07:00 EET must be deferred until 07:00 EET the following day. By implement-
ing these controls, the project sought to deliver a seamless customer experience, ensure regulatory
compliance, and strengthen operational efficiency in loan servicing.
• Led Agile delivery of loan application, top-up, and disbursement functionality across Nordea
Finland’s digital channels (mobile, internet banking, and call center), ensuring compliance
with Finnish Consumer Rights legislation.
• Facilitated Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives) to drive
iterative progress across requirement gathering, system design, development, and testing.
• Collaborated with cross-functional squads (Core Banking, Compliance, Risk, IT, and
Operations) to prioritize backlog items and deliver incremental features aligned with
regulatory mandates.
• Defined user stories and acceptance criteria to enforce business rules requiring deferred
disbursement of loans approved between 23:00 EET and 07:00 EET until 07:00 EET the
following day.
• Managed sprint-based integration activities, ensuring seamless processing across loan
origination, approval, and disbursement modules while maintaining compliance with
consumer protection laws.
• Partnered with stakeholders and vendors to validate solution design, conduct proof-of- concept trials, and optimize system performance for 24/7 loan servicing.
• Developed training and enablement materials for customer service and operations teams to ensure smooth adoption of new loan disbursement processes.
• Applied Agile metrics (velocity, burndown charts, defect tracking) to monitor delivery
progress, identify risks, and proactively mitigate issues during rollout.
• Delivered measurable outcomes, enabling 24/7 loan servicing, ensuring compliance with
Finnish legislation, and enhancing customer trust in Nordea Finland’s digital banking
services.

details: ➔ Client : CHEVRON, USA
The goal of the project was to transform Chevron Lubricants’ global Service Center operations
by standardizing on Salesforce Service Cloud and leveraging its matured functionalities and
industry best practices. This initiative supported the launch of Chevron Business Point 2.0 (CBP),
an e-commerce platform designed to enhance customer engagement through new digital
channels. The project aimed to modernize customer service processes, improve responsiveness,
and enable seamless integration with CBP 2.0, starting with pilot rollouts at LBST and Lubetek
before expanding to other Chevron businesses, including Marine and Europe. By doing so, Chevron
sought to maximize its investment in Salesforce Service Cloud, strengthen customer
relationships, and drive operational excellence across its global service network.
• Directed end-to-end project delivery using the Waterfall methodology, overseeing
requirements gathering, design, development, testing, and global rollout of Salesforce
Service Cloud enhancements.
• Defined detailed project scope, timelines, and milestones, ensuring alignment with
Chevron’s strategic objective of transforming Service Center operations and supporting CBP
2.0 launch.
• Coordinated with business stakeholders across LBST, Lubetek, Marine, and European
divisions to capture requirements and establish standardized processes for customer
engagement.
• Managed vendor and internal IT teams to configure and implement matured Salesforce
Service Cloud functionalities, ensuring adherence to industry best practices.
• Oversaw pilot implementations at LBST and Lubetek, validating functionality, gathering
feedback, and preparing for phased expansion to other Chevron businesses.
• Developed comprehensive documentation including functional specifications, test plans,
operational manuals, and training materials to support global adoption.
• Monitored project progress against baseline schedules, budgets, and quality standards,
escalating risks and implementing corrective actions where necessary.
• Ensured compliance with Chevron’s governance frameworks, change management

Domain : Telecom
The goal of the project was to modernize AT&T’s core IP/MPLS backbone to significantly increase
network capacity, enable software-defined networking (SDN) capabilities, and enhance overall reli- ability for both consumer and enterprise services. This initiative aimed to deliver a more scalable,
resilient, and future-ready infrastructure by deploying next-generation routers and switches, exe- cuting seamless live traffic migrations, and integrating vendor solutions in compliance with archi-
tectural standards. The program was designed to improve customer experience through 40% latency
reduction and 70% capacity increase, while achieving cost efficiency by delivering the project un- der budget.
• Directed the full project lifecycle of a multi-year IP/MPLS backbone modernization pro- gram, applying Waterfall methodology from requirements gathering through design, pro-
curement, deployment, and cutover.
• Managed cross-functional teams (Network Engineering, Planning, Operations, Security) to deliver phased upgrades of core routers and switches, ensuring compliance with AT&T’s ar-
chitectural and reliability standards.
• Developed detailed project schedules, milestone plans, and dependency tracking to drive
execution and ensure timely delivery across all phases.
• Executed structured migration plans for live customer traffic, coordinating cutovers with
zero unplanned service outages.
• Oversaw vendor contracts and deliverables, ensuring seamless technology integration and
adherence to compliance and security requirements.
• Controlled a $10M+ capital budget, delivering the program 5% under budget while achieving
technical KPIs (40% latency reduction, 70% capacity increase).
• Implemented formal risk and change management processes, proactively mitigating service
disruption risks and ensuring smooth transitions.
• Prepared governance reports and stakeholder communications, providing transparent up- dates on progress, risks, and financial performance to executive leadership.

testing, and optimization of VoLTE and VoWiFi services.
• Implemented structured risk and change management processes, proactively addressing po- tential service disruptions and ensuring smooth transitions.

setup times, and laying the foundation for future 5G VoNR services.

details: ➔ Client : CHEVRON, USA
The goal of the project was to transform Chevron Lubricants’ global Service Center operations
by standardizing on Salesforce Service Cloud and leveraging its matured functionalities and
industry best practices. This initiative supported the launch of Chevron Business Point 2.0 (CBP),
an e-commerce platform designed to enhance customer engagement through new digital
channels. The project aimed to modernize customer service processes, improve responsiveness,
and enable seamless integration with CBP 2.0, starting with pilot rollouts at LBST and Lubetek
before expanding to other Chevron businesses, including Marine and Europe. By doing so, Chevron
sought to maximize its investment in Salesforce Service Cloud, strengthen customer
relationships, and drive operational excellence across its global service network.
• Directed end-to-end project delivery using the Waterfall methodology, overseeing
requirements gathering, design, development, testing, and global rollout of Salesforce
Service Cloud enhancements.
• Defined detailed project scope, timelines, and milestones, ensuring alignment with
Chevron’s strategic objective of transforming Service Center operations and supporting CBP
2.0 launch.
• Coordinated with business stakeholders across LBST, Lubetek, Marine, and European
divisions to capture requirements and establish standardized processes for customer
engagement.
• Managed vendor and internal IT teams to configure and implement matured Salesforce
Service Cloud functionalities, ensuring adherence to industry best practices.
• Oversaw pilot implementations at LBST and Lubetek, validating functionality, gathering
feedback, and preparing for phased expansion to other Chevron businesses.
• Developed comprehensive documentation including functional specifications, test plans,
operational manuals, and training materials to support global adoption.
• Monitored project progress against baseline schedules, budgets, and quality standards,
escalating risks and implementing corrective actions where necessary.
• Ensured compliance with Chevron’s governance frameworks, change management
protocols, and global operational standards.
• Delivered measurable outcomes, enabling standardized customer service processes,
improved responsiveness, and maximized ROI from Salesforce Service Cloud investment.

details: ➔ Client : AT&T (USA)
Domain : Telecom
The goal of the project was to modernize AT&T’s core IP/MPLS backbone to significantly increase
network capacity, enable software-defined networking (SDN) capabilities, and enhance overall reli- ability for both consumer and enterprise services. This initiative aimed to deliver a more scalable,
resilient, and future-ready infrastructure by deploying next-generation routers and switches, exe- cuting seamless live traffic migrations, and integrating vendor solutions in compliance with archi-
tectural standards. The program was designed to improve customer experience through 40% latency
reduction and 70% capacity increase, while achieving cost efficiency by delivering the project un- der budget.
• Directed the full project lifecycle of a multi-year IP/MPLS backbone modernization pro- gram, applying Waterfall methodology from requirements gathering through design, pro-
curement, deployment, and cutover.
• Managed cross-functional teams (Network Engineering, Planning, Operations, Security) to deliver phased upgrades of core routers and switches, ensuring compliance with AT&T’s ar-
chitectural and reliability standards.
• Developed detailed project schedules, milestone plans, and dependency tracking to drive
execution and ensure timely delivery across all phases.
• Executed structured migration plans for live customer traffic, coordinating cutovers with
zero unplanned service outages.
• Oversaw vendor contracts and deliverables, ensuring seamless technology integration and
adherence to compliance and security requirements.
• Controlled a $10M+ capital budget, delivering the program 5% under budget while achieving
technical KPIs (40% latency reduction, 70% capacity increase).
• Implemented formal risk and change management processes, proactively mitigating service
disruption risks and ensuring smooth transitions.
• Prepared governance reports and stakeholder communications, providing transparent up- dates on progress, risks, and financial performance to executive leadership.
➔ Client : AT&T (USA)
Role : Project Manager
Domain : Telecom
The goal of the project was to transform AT&T’s voice services by migrating from legacy circuit- switched (TDM) infrastructure to a cloud-native IMS platform, enabling advanced VoLTE and VoWiFi
capabilities. This initiative aimed to deliver superior voice quality (HD Voice), faster call setup
times, and seamless subscriber experience, while ensuring service integrity during the migration of
over 2 million customers. Additionally, the project established the foundational architecture for
future 5G VoNR services, positioning AT&T for next-generation voice innovation.
• Directed the full project lifecycle of migrating voice services from legacy TDM switches to a
cloud-native IMS platform, applying Waterfall methodology from requirements gathering
through design, testing, deployment, and cutover.
• Coordinated cross-functional teams (Cloud Infrastructure, SBC, Telephony Application
Server, Device Certification) to ensure end-to-end service integrity and compliance with
AT&T’s standards.
• Developed detailed project schedules, milestone plans, and dependency tracking to man- age complex migration activities for 2M+ subscribers.
• Managed cutover execution and fallback strategies, minimizing risk and ensuring uninter- rupted service during subscriber migration.
• Collaborated with vendors (Ericsson, Nokia) to oversee solution integration, performance
testing, and optimization of VoLTE and VoWiFi services.
• Implemented structured risk and change management processes, proactively addressing po- tential service disruptions and ensuring smooth transitions.
• Delivered the project on schedule, enabling superior voice quality (HD Voice), faster call
setup times, and laying the foundation for future 5G VoNR services.
• Prepared governance reports and stakeholder communications, providing transparent up- dates on progress, risks, and performance outcomes to executive leadership.
➔ Client : AT&T (USA)
Role : Team Lead
Domain : Telecom
The goal of the project was to launch a new IoT connectivity management platform and integrate a
strategic Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) partner into AT&T’s network ecosystem, ena- bling seamless device provisioning, billing, and policy control through standardized APIs. This initia-
tive aimed to establish scalable operational processes and SLAs to support partner onboarding,
drive enterprise adoption, and generate new revenue streams. The program successfully delivered
an integrated platform that activated over 500,000 connected devices and generated $7M in annual
recurring revenue, strengthening AT&T’s position in the IoT and MVNO markets.
• Directed the full project lifecycle for launching a new IoT connectivity management plat- form and onboarding a strategic MVNO partner, applying Waterfall methodology from re-
quirements gathering through design, integration, testing, and deployment.
• Served as the single point of contact between external partners/vendors and internal teams
(network, IT, billing, legal), ensuring seamless coordination and alignment with AT&T’s
standards.
• Defined and managed implementation of critical interfaces (APIs) for provisioning, billing,
and network policy control, ensuring interoperability and compliance with operational re- quirements.
• Developed detailed project schedules, milestone tracking, and dependency management to drive execution across multiple workstreams and ensure timely delivery.
• Established and documented operational processes and SLAs, enabling effective partner
support and long-term sustainability post-launch.
• Oversaw vendor deliverables and solution integration, ensuring adherence to technical
specifications, performance benchmarks, and contractual obligations.
• Implemented structured risk and change management processes, proactively mitigating po- tential service disruptions during platform rollout and MVNO onboarding.
• Delivered measurable business outcomes, successfully enabling activation of 500,000+ con- nected devices and generating $7M in new annual recurring revenue.
➔ Client : AT&T (USA)
Role : Team Lead
Domain : Telecom
The goal of the project was to design, test, and commercially launch a new managed SD-WAN ser- vice for enterprise customers using universal Customer Premises Equipment (uCPE). This initiative
aimed to expand AT&T’s enterprise portfolio by delivering a scalable, flexible, and cost-efficient
connectivity solution. The program focused on vendor selection and integration of Virtual Network
Functions (VNFs), development of standardized deployment playbooks, and alignment with product,
marketing, and sales teams to ensure a successful go-to-market strategy. The project was designed
to accelerate enterprise adoption, improve service agility, and generate new revenue streams,
achieving $5M in initial contract value ahead of schedule.
• Directed the full project lifecycle for the design, testing, and commercial launch of a new
managed SD-WAN service utilizing universal Customer Premises Equipment (uCPE), applying
Waterfall methodology from requirements gathering through deployment.
• Managed vendor selection and evaluation process for Virtual Network Functions (VNFs) and
uCPE hardware, leading technical assessments, proof-of-concept trials, and final contract
negotiations.
• Collaborated with Product Management to define service features and with Marketing/Sales
teams to develop go-to-market strategies and sales enablement materials.
• Developed standardized deployment playbooks and operational runbooks, ensuring scalable
rollout and consistent service delivery across enterprise customers.
• Created detailed project schedules, milestone tracking, and dependency management to drive execution across design, testing, and launch phases.
• Oversaw vendor deliverables and solution integration, ensuring adherence to technical
specifications, performance benchmarks, and compliance requirements.
• Implemented structured risk and change management processes, proactively mitigating po- tential service disruptions during rollout.
• Delivered the service ahead of schedule, capturing $5M in initial contract value and estab- lishing a new enterprise revenue stream.
